title: Narendra Singh Panwar v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala and Vipin Sinha, JJ.
disposition: Recovery citation stayed; writ connected and listed.
headnote: Pending a challenge to clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the Allahabad High Court connected Writ-C No. 40469 of 2016 with Writ-C No. 8370 of 2016, issued notice to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7, and directed that the recovery citation shall not be enforced against the petitioner, while leaving the respondents free to recover the dues from respondent no. 7. Later orders only listed the matter.
facts: Narendra Singh Panwar filed Writ-C No. 40469 of 2016 at the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and six others after a recovery citation was issued against him. Clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was under challenge in connected Writ-C No. 8370 of 2016. The Division Bench connected the petitions and issued notice to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7. Subsequent orders of 5 September 2016 and 24 February 2023 only listed the writ.

holding_units.topic: interim stay of recovery pending challenge to clause 4.3(f)(v)
holding_units.holding: Because clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was under challenge in the connected writ, the Court issued notice to the Advocate General and respondent no. 7, directed that the recovery citation shall not be enforced against the petitioner, and left it open to the respondents to recover the dues from respondent no. 7, while connecting and listing the petition.

not_decided.point: Validity of clause 4.3(f)(v) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Notice issued to the Advocate General; the clause was not construed or upheld on merits.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's liability for the electricity dues
